description: Map location picker (user item 3: 'make the app so I can point the location'). Add an interactive map where the user drops/drags a pin to choose coordinates, alongside the existing 'Use my location' and text search in lib/features/location/presentation/location_selector.dart. Use flutter_map + latlong2 with OpenStreetMap tiles (no API key, works on Android + web, consistent with the app's key-free OSM/Nominatim ethos; google_maps_flutter is rejected because it needs a key and does not run on Flutter web, which this app now deploys to). On confirm, reverse-geocode the pinned lat/lon via NominatimService.reverse to fill city/country and call LocationController.selectManual. OSM tile attribution must stay visible. Functionally independent of the other features.
steps: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml near the location deps: 'flutter_map: ^7.0.2' and 'latlong2: ^0.9.1' (known compatible with Flutter 3.35 / Dart 3.9). The sandbox cannot resolve pub; note in the PR body that the user must run flutter pub get. Add a brief comment explaining the key-free OSM choice.

Create lib/features/location/presentation/map_location_picker.dart: a ConsumerStatefulWidget that shows a FlutterMap with an OpenStreetMap TileLayer (urlTemplate 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', userAgentPackageName 'plantsense_ai') centred on the current selected location if any (ref.read(selectedLocationProvider)) else a sensible default (the demo Amman coords 31.9539,35.9106). Let the user move the pin by tapping the map (onTap sets the pin LatLng) and/or dragging a centre marker; show a fixed centre crosshair or a MarkerLayer marker at the chosen point. Include a visible OSM attribution (RichAttributionWidget/SimpleAttributionWidget or a small localized '© OpenStreetMap contributors' text) matching the precedent that the aerial card keeps Esri attribution visible. Provide a confirm button (localized) and a loading state while reverse-geocoding.

On confirm: read the pinned lat/lon, call ref.read(nominatimServiceProvider).reverse(lat, lon, locale: ref.read(appLocaleCodeProvider)); build a PlantLocation from the result, or when reverse returns null fall back to PlantLocation(latitude, longitude, city: <localized 'Dropped pin' label>, isManual: true); then ref.read(locationControllerProvider.notifier).selectManual(loc) and pop/close, invoking the onSelected callback.

Integrate into location_selector.dart: add a third option (an OutlinedButton.icon with Icons.map_outlined labelled with a new localized string like 'Pick on map') below 'Use my location' that opens the MapLocationPicker (push a full-screen route or a large modal bottom sheet). When the picker selects a location, propagate widget.onSelected so the existing bottom sheet closes. Keep the existing 'Use my location' and search UI unchanged.

Graceful web/degradation: flutter_map works on web, but guard tile loading errors (TileLayer errorTileCallback or a fallback message) so a blocked tile server does not crash the picker. Ensure the picker is sized so it works in both a full-screen route and a bottom sheet.

Native config: OSM raster tiles over flutter_map need only INTERNET (already added by both setup scripts) and no extra Android/iOS permission. Confirm this and add nothing to the scripts unless flutter_map's platform docs require it for the chosen version; if so, add the same entry to BOTH tool/setup_platforms.sh and tool/setup_platforms.ps1.

Add ARB keys to BOTH app_en.arb and app_ar.arb for: the 'Pick on map' button, the map picker screen title, the confirm button, and the 'Dropped pin' fallback city label. Keep exact key parity and add @-metadata mirroring neighbouring keys.

Hand-add each new key to all 5 generated l10n files (abstract getter in app_localizations.dart + en/ar real strings + es/fr English fallback in their impl files), matching dart format's 80-column two-line wrap.

Add a provider test test/providers/map_picker_flow_test.dart driving the reverse-geocode-then-selectManual flow with a fake NominatimService: override nominatimServiceProvider with a fake returning a known PlantLocation for given coords, invoke the same logic the confirm button runs (extract the confirm handler into a small testable method/function if the button closure is not directly callable), and assert locationControllerProvider ends with status ready and the expected location; add a second case where reverse returns null and assert the fallback PlantLocation (correct lat/lon, fallback city, isManual true) is applied. Follow the ProviderContainer + defaultOverrides pattern; add a fake NominatimService to test/mocks/mocks.dart or build a purpose-made fake in the test file.
Optionally update README 'Third-party integrations' to mention flutter_map + OSM tiles, consistent with the existing OSM/Esri documentation.
acceptance_criteria: pubspec.yaml lists flutter_map ^7.0.2 and latlong2 ^0.9.1; no google_maps_flutter added.
location_selector.dart offers a 'Pick on map' action that opens an interactive OSM map where the user can move a pin.

Confirming the pin reverse-geocodes via NominatimService.reverse and calls LocationController.selectManual; when reverse returns null a fallback PlantLocation with the pinned coords and a localized 'Dropped pin' city is applied.
OSM '© OpenStreetMap contributors' attribution is visible on the map.
Map picker builds for web (raster TileLayer) and handles tile load failure without crashing.
New ARB keys keep app_en.arb/app_ar.arb parity and exist in all 5 generated l10n files (fr/es English fallback).
test/providers/map_picker_flow_test.dart passes (verified by the user): both the reverse-geocode-success and reverse-returns-null fallback paths call selectManual with the correct PlantLocation.
verification: grep -n 'flutter_map\|latlong2' pubspec.yaml shows both deps; grep confirms no google_maps_flutter
python3 parity + getter-coverage harness pass for the new keys
User runs: flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && dart format lib test integration_test

findings.summary: Added a flutter_map + OpenStreetMap pin-drop location picker. New MapLocationPicker (lib/features/location/presentation/map_location_picker.dart) shows a FlutterMap with OSM raster TileLayer (tile.openstreetmap.org, userAgentPackageName 'plantsense_ai'), centred on selectedLocationProvider or the Amman default (31.9539,35.9106). User taps to move the pin (MarkerLayer with a location_on marker). Visible RichAttributionWidget '© OpenStreetMap contributors'. Confirm button reverse-geocodes and applies via the controller. errorTileCallback surfaces a localized hint (geocodeFailed) on tile failure instead of crashing on web. showMapLocationPicker() opens it as an 85%-height modal bottom sheet. Wired a third OutlinedButton.icon (Icons.map_outlined, locationPickOnMap) into location_selector.dart that propagates onSelected so the outer sheet closes.
findings.testable_confirm_logic: Extracted the reverse-then-selectManual flow (with null fallback) into LocationController.selectPinnedLocation({lat, lon, fallbackCity}) in location_provider.dart. The widget passes l10n.mapDroppedPin as fallbackCity (controller has no BuildContext). test/providers/map_picker_flow_test.dart drives this directly via ProviderContainer + defaultOverrides + a FakeNominatimService override (added to test/mocks/mocks.dart): success case asserts status ready with the geocoded PlantLocation; null case asserts fallback PlantLocation with the pinned lat/lon, city 'Dropped pin', isManual true.
findings.deps: pubspec.yaml gains flutter_map: ^7.0.2 and latlong2: ^0.9.1 (with an explanatory comment on the key-free OSM/web choice). No google_maps_flutter. The sandbox cannot resolve pub, so the USER MUST RUN 'flutter pub get' (which also re-runs gen-l10n) before flutter analyze / test / dart format.
findings.l10n: Added 4 keys to BOTH app_en.arb and app_ar.arb keeping exact parity (413 -> 417). Keys: locationPickOnMap, mapPickerTitle, mapPickerConfirm, mapDroppedPin. No @-metadata (they have no placeholders, matching neighbouring location keys). Hand-wired all 4 into all 5 generated files: abstract getter + doc comment in app_localizations.dart, real EN in _en, real AR in _ar, English fallback in _es and _fr (matching gen-l10n fallback for still-stubbed ARBs). FEAT-001 parity harness reports 'parity OK 417' and the getter-coverage harness confirms all 4 present in all 5 files.
findings.native: OSM raster tiles over flutter_map need only android.permission.INTERNET, already present once in each of tool/setup_platforms.sh and tool/setup_platforms.ps1. No script change made.
findings.verification: Static only (no Flutter SDK / pub / internet in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox): ARB parity 417, getter-coverage green, brace/paren balance 0 0 on all edited Dart files, both ARBs valid JSON, INTERNET present in both setup scripts. The only >80-col lines in new Dart are an import and a doc comment (dart format never wraps those). USER MUST RUN on their toolchain: flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && dart format lib test integration_test.
findings.api_notes: Used flutter_map 7.x API surface: FlutterMap(mapController, options: MapOptions(initialCenter/initialZoom/onTap), children: [TileLayer(urlTemplate, userAgentPackageName, errorTileCallback), MarkerLayer, RichAttributionWidget(attributions:[TextSourceAttribution])]). RichAttributionWidget left non-const for version robustness. If pub resolves flutter_map to a newer major with a changed callback/attribution signature the user should adjust, but 7.0.2 matches this code.
findings.readme: Added a 'flutter_map + OpenStreetMap tiles' bullet under README 'Third-party integrations', consistent with the existing Nominatim/Esri entries and noting attribution must stay visible.
